propositions: signing.py at 800 LOC is at hard cap with zero headroom; any edit fails the module-size CI gate

Three concerns in signing.py (manifest vocabulary, legacy HMAC scheme, attestation dispatch) can be split along existing call-graph seams into _signing_manifest.py (216 LOC), _signing_hmac.py (276 LOC), and a reduced signing.py (435 LOC)

Monkeypatch patches on _baked_commit_sha in test_attestation_signing.py become no-ops after the split unless re-anchored to rebar._signing_manifest, causing one vacuous-pass test to silently stop testing live-over-baked precedence
The split requires re-pointing three test patches from signing module to _signing_manifest module and adding a positive guard test to close the vacuous-pass risk
All nine signing.* callables in test_reuse_surface_doc.py and six private names must remain re-exported from signing.py with unchanged parameter lists to maintain backward compatibility
